title: Bounmy SENGMANY (father, holds the family phone)
description: Persona: Somsack's father, 29, head of the household in Lao PDR, who holds the family's one shared phone (J4). Creates Somsack's passcode-protected VHL (J4.0) and says the passcode aloud at the clinic (J4.1). Fictional.

persona.name: Bounmy
persona.goal: Keep the whole family's health records in one place he controls.
needs: One app for three people on one phone
Decide who sees what, and for how long
frustrations: Carrying folders of documents across the border
Not knowing who has seen his child’s data
